metadata.dcterms:creator: ITEP
Moscow
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We consider functions on the lattice generated by the integer powers of q2 for 0 < q < 1 and construct the q-analog of Fourier transform based on the Jackson integral in the space of distributions on the lattice.
